input.quote: 10. NONASSIGNABILITY. Neither party shall assign, transfer, or subcontract this Agreement or any of its obligations hereunder without the other party's express, prior written consent, which will not be unreasonably withheld.
input.rationale: Section 10 is the only assignment provision; there is no change-of-control language anywhere in the Agreement, so no Contractor termination or re-pricing right is triggered by our change of control (that element is fine). However, the clause subjects every Company assignment — including to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets — to Contractor's consent. It therefore fails both the preferred position and the fallback, which requires at minimum a right to assign to a successor (on notice) with consent only for other assignments. The reasonableness qualifier mitigates but does not cure the absence of any M&A/affiliate carve-out. Redline adds the affiliate/successor carve-out for Company and bars Contractor from assigning to a Company competitor, leaving the mutual reasonable-consent standard otherwise intact.

proposal.summary: Add Customer affiliate/successor assignment carve-out and bar assignment to a Company competitor
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added the customary carve-out allowing Company to assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets without consent, and confirmed Contractor may not assign to a Company competitor. Our playbook requires corporate reorganisations and M&A not to be blocked by a consent right; if helpful, we can accept a mutual successor-assignment right on written notice instead.

ops.oldText: without the other party's express, prior written consent, which will not be unreasonably withheld.
ops.newText: without the other party's express, prior written consent, which will not be unreasonably withheld; provided that Company may assign this Agreement, without consent, to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets, and Contractor shall not assign this Agreement to a competitor of Company.
